parsed.note_claim: The claim that Ugandan authorities ordered a gay couple to give birth or face jail is false.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: There is no evidence to validate the claim that President Museveni of Uganda said a jailed gay couple will be released only when one gets pregnant. Thus, the claim is FALSE.
parsed.reason: The fact-check article explicitly concludes that the viral claim regarding Ugandan authorities and gay couples is false due to lack of evidence.
